19. Safe house is a shelter or temporary protection house for victims during the assistance process to ensure the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators and is only known to interested parties for reasons of victim safety and security.
20. Child-friendly regency is a regency that has a child rights-based development system through the integration of commitment and resources of government, community, business world, and media that are planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights and special protection of children.

Article 9
Women's empowerment in the economic field as referred to in Article 8 letter a shall be implemented through:
a. provision of skills and job training;
b. facilitation of the formation of productive economic business groups; c. facilitation of strengthening and development of productive economic business groups; d. facilitation and capital assistance; and
e. facilitation of marketing network development.

7.3.rationale: Funding sources: Pasal 37(2) states financing may come from “sumber pembiayaan lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat,” which could include donors, and Pasal 33(1) huruf f explicitly mentions “bantuan internasional” in the context of supporting empowerment/protection efforts. While not a detailed budget line, it indicates international assistance as a potential resource. Thus a “Yes” for international donors is supportable; the golden “No” seems inconsistent with the Indonesian text.
